summary: Two-lag autoregression. Depending on the φ₁, φ₂ pair, the dynamics range from smooth mean-reversion to damped oscillation. The (φ₁, φ₂) plane is the standard map between parameters and qualitative behaviour.

ranges.phrase: Strong oscillatory tendency — the second-lag coefficient pulls back hard.
Mild oscillatory tendency — visible cyclic structure, not overwhelming.
Smooth dynamics — second-lag coefficient reinforces the first; no cyclic pattern.
